To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the SQUAD task is a challenging and important task for the NLP community, and 2) the use of span representations is an important step forward in the development of more accurate extractive reading comprehension models.

We present a novel architecture for extractive reading comprehension that builds fixed-length span representations with a recurrent network, and show that this significantly outperforms prior work on the SQuAD dataset.

(1) recurrent span representations are a useful intermediate representation for answer extraction, (2) the span representations are most useful when the model scores all spans in the document, (3) our model is more effective than the state of the art, and (4) the span representations can be efficiently computed with a recurrent network.
